svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make four, all the same: two for the enclosure plate, two for the arm plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Blank 150 x 40 mm of 3 mm sheet: a 20 mm flat in the middle and a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 65 mm wing each side. Scribe the two bend lines 10 mm each side

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bend each wing 45 degrees in a vice with soft jaws, inside radius

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: about 3 mm, so the two wings meet at 90 degrees (the V).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two holes on the centre line of the flat, 10 mm each side of the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: middle: drill 3.3 mm and tap M4. File the screw tails flush later.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the flat sits on the back of a saddle plate, the V opens toward

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the pole; two M4 countersunk screws from the plate's front.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The 114 mm pole touches both wings 43 mm out from the bends;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 60 to 140 mm poles also seat on both wings.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: both wings at 45 degrees to the flat, within 1 degree.
